 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 25th Match - Adelaide Strikers Women vs Sydney Sixers Women , to be played on the 17th of November at the Karen Rolton Oval, Adelaide.
 Match Prediction - Adelaide Strikers Women v Sydney Sixers Women 
 25th Match - Adelaide Strikers Women vs Sydney Sixers Women (Karen Rolton Oval, Adelaide) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Karen Rolton Oval, Adelaide (Women's Big Bash League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Karen Rolton Oval, Adelaide (Women's Big Bash League) - 142 
 Batting Stats WOMENT20 
 Current Form Adelaide Strikers Women:
 Adelaide Strikers Women are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 wins, 3 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.215. 
 The top run scorer for Adelaide Strikers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Knight with 187 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Adelaide Strikers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Voll with 6 scalps under her belt. 
 Adelaide Strikers Women have won their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by a huge margin of 51 runs.
 Adelaide Strikers Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 202 for 4 in 20 overs. Maia Bouchier got out cheaply. After her dismissal, Emma de Broughe and Laura Wolvaardt played really well. Emma made 51 runs while Laura Wolvaardt smashed 83 runs off only 45 balls, hitting 7 fours and 4 sixes. Madeline Penna also played to her potential and scored 44 runs in only 19 deliveries as Adelaide Strikers Women managed to reach a tall total of 202 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Perth Scorchers Women couldn't get off to an ideal start. They were reduced to 33 for 3 in the 6th over itself. Freya Kemp and Mikayla Hinkley scored a few quick runs but they also gifted their wicket away at a wrong time. After their dismissals, wickets started to fall in regular succession and Perth Scorchers Women didn't look like chasing the total down. Anesu Mushangwe picked up 5 wickets for 11 runs as Perth Scorchers Women were eventually restricted to 151 for 9 in 20 overs, losing the match by a big margin of 51 runs.
 Current Form Sydney Sixers Women:
 Sydney Sixers Women on the other hand are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 1 win and 5 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.602. 
 The top run scorer for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Meg Lanning with 254 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Annabel Sutherland with 7 scalps under her belt. 
 Sydney Sixers Women have lost their previous match against Melbourne Renegades Women by 2 wickets.
 Sydney Sixers Women batted first and they posted a total of 152 for 6 in 20 overs. Ellyse Perry got out after scoring just 3 runs. After her dismissal, Sophia Dunkley and Amelia Kerr played well and stitched a partnership of 51 runs for the 2nd wicket. After Kerr and Dunkley got out, Ashleigh Gardner took over. She smashed 55 runs off only 31 balls and helped Sydney Sixers Women get past the 150 run mark, as they finished at 152 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Melbourne Renegades Women lost their way right from the word go. They kept losing wickets in regular succession and were reduced to 61 for 5 in the 12th over itself. After that phase, Sophie Molineux and Chloe Tryon played really well. Molineux made 38 runs in just 25 balls. It all came down to 13 runs to get off the last over. Chloe Tryon hit 2 timely boundaries to seal the deal in favor of Melbourne Renegades Women. With 1 run to get off the last ball, Nicole Faltum hit a boundary as Melbourne Renegades Women managed to get over the line on the last ball of the match with 2 wickets in hand.
